description: This file defines a selector generator for DOM elements, providing functions to create CSS and XPath selectors based on element attributes, hierarchy, and accessibility features. It includes scoring mechanisms to determine the most reliable selector for a given element, supporting features like shadow DOM traversal and accessibility roles.

classes.name: SelectorToken
classes.description: Represents a selector with its engine type, selector string, and score indicating reliability.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Caches for allowed and disallowed text selectors for elements.

methods.name: generateSelector
methods.description: Main function to generate a selector for a target element based on options, returning the best selector, all candidate selectors, and matching elements.

methods.name: generateSelectorFor
methods.description: Generates a selector token array for a specific element, considering text and no-text candidates, and nesting options.

methods.name: buildNoTextCandidates
methods.description: Builds candidate selectors based on attributes, labels, roles, and other non-text features.

methods.name: buildTextCandidates
methods.description: Builds candidate selectors based on text content, including titles, alt text, labels, and accessible names.

methods.name: makeSelectorForId
methods.description: Creates a CSS selector for an element ID, using a simple ID selector if possible.

methods.name: hasCSSIdToken
methods.description: Checks if a set of selector tokens includes a CSS ID selector.

methods.name: cssFallback
methods.description: Generates a fallback CSS selector path for an element based on ID, classes, and position in the DOM.

methods.name: penalizeScoreForLength
methods.description: Adjusts selector token scores based on their length to prefer shorter, more reliable selectors.

methods.name: joinTokens
methods.description: Joins an array of selector tokens into a string selector, using '>>' as combinator for different engines.

methods.name: combineScores
methods.description: Calculates a combined score for a set of selector tokens, lower scores are better.

methods.name: isGuidLike
methods.description: Determines if an ID string resembles a GUID based on character transitions.

methods.name: trimWordBoundary
methods.description: Trims text to a maximum length at a word boundary.

methods.name: suitableTextAlternatives
methods.description: Provides alternative text snippets with score bonuses for better selector robustness.

methods.name: escapeNodeName
methods.description: Escapes node names for use in query selectors.

methods.name: escapeClassName
methods.description: Escapes class names for use in query selectors.

methods.name: cssEscapeCharacter
methods.description: Escapes individual characters for CSS identifiers.
